configuration.kernel_source: sibling mccl/native/index; raw runtime compile, MCCL offline metallib
configuration.mccl_items: native preferred items8; capability fallback items4 can occur under GPU instrumentation; use uninstrumented launch

method.allocation: raw pipelines/output buffers outside samples; one persistent three-buffer pool. MCCL allocates output/scratch per call from its cache. All source handles are retained across variants; no per-build population
method.copy: raw_copy_rows reads retained source and writes output; logical traffic 16N, not measured DRAM bytes. This is explicitly a copy reference, not index construction
method.encoder_control: normal raw uses one serial compute encoder per stage. Controlled three-buffer single concurrent uses explicit buffer-scope barriers after every sort dispatch, including before directory. Single serial uses no explicit barriers. Same Sort stage generator and pools
method.initial_touch: only source ingestion CPU-writes relation data; raw index outputs, directory and scratch are uninitialized until GPU execution. CPU validation reads completed outputs outside timing
method.mlx_gpu_timestamps: unavailable: pinned public mlx/c/metal.h only offers capture; no safe command-buffer timestamp accessor. eval wall includes CPU scheduling and readiness waits, not GPU execution
method.order: all seven variants rotate by case+round; every result fully checked after timing; retained source data never repopulated
method.source: identical immutable packed u32 key/payload relation ingested ONCE per backend per case; all repetitions reuse the source handle
method.timing: total ends after ready output, before first CPU scan and correctness. Phase instrumentation getrusage and JSON recording lies inside diagnostic totals; public API total has only outer instrumentation. No DRAM counters or GPU faults collected
method.validation: CPU stable reference sorted outside timing; every row and duplicate payload order, every directory offset, prefix-boundary/present/adjacent lookup probes; immutable raw/C input compared after output scan
method.workspace: exact historical workspace/pool fixture: ((source_row_id*40503)&65535)*65537; full-width repeated keys and source row-ID payloads
